    • setUpTransformerCtxInJelly

      public static org.apache.commons.jelly.JellyContext setUpTransformerCtxInJelly()
      Creates a Jelly context and initializes a TransformerContext for it. This method creates a ComponentBuilderData object that is initialized with a new instance of this class. It is stored in a Jelly context. This method is especially useful for test cases for Jelly tag handler classes that need access to the objects wrapped by a TransformerContext, e.g. a resource manager.
